subject.title: feat: trace Claude Code CLI model calls

question: Should opaque Claude and Codex CLI turns become a new turn-level diagnostic lifecycle, or should trusted `model.call` permanently support both provider requests and aggregate turns while also allowing non-visible thinking capture?
rationale: This changes the durable meaning and privacy boundary of trusted diagnostic events across runtimes and exporters; tests cannot choose that public observability contract.

options.title: Separate turn lifecycle
options.body: Keep `model.call` request-only, emit opaque CLI activity through a dedicated turn event, and exclude thinking from captured output.

options.title: Approve dual-purpose model calls
options.body: Retain `observationUnit: "turn"` under `model.call`, document every consumer's obligations, and explicitly decide whether thinking is part of the trusted capture contract.

recommendation.title: Separate turn lifecycle
recommendation.body: Keep `model.call` request-only, emit opaque CLI activity through a dedicated turn event, and exclude thinking from captured output.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the core CLI-runner and trusted diagnostics contracts, where this owner has recent adjacent merged history.
